newsitem.title: USA: Birmingham start-up costs to offset Q3 net.
newsitem.headline: Birmingham start-up costs to offset Q3 net.

text.p: Birmingham Steel Corp said Friday it expected to set production and shipment records during its third quarter, but warned start-up costs from several expansion projects will offset satisfactory earnings from ongoing operations.
Birmingham said start-up costs were higher than expected at its Cartersville melt shop, although that plant also is achieving better-than-expected production.
The company also said it is "not fully satisfied" with the financial performance of its Cleveland acquisition.

"Although the start-up of these projects will have a negative impact on our third-quarter results, they are strategic steps that will better position the company to achieve our market-share and profitability objectives," Birmingham's Chairman Robert Garvey said in a statement.
